dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline curvature along the trailing edge from the posterior insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small pixel radius resulting in a rounded-acute shape classification.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree incline relative to the dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width is approximately 1.1 times the vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Shallow convex arc fitted to the anterior-dorsal boundary of the head.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Extremely high length-to-thickness ratio; thin, needle-like projection extending linearly from the head.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Visible obtuse angle approximately 160 degrees at the pixel transition from melon to rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan-teal monochromatic coloration and a singular, elongated tusk-like structure on the rostrum.
